marie-ledezma.text: Pledges to 'Advocate for ordinances that work, cut red tape, and expand economic opportunities,' protect green spaces and rebuild aging infrastructure.

source.title: City of Montebello - 2026 Candidate Statement: Marie Ledezma

elva-sammy-osorio.text: Says 'I will address homelessness with balance: combining mental health help and shelter with real safety rules.'

source.title: City of Montebello - 2026 Candidate Statement: Elva "Sammy" Osorio

elva-sammy-osorio.text: Pledges to audit city spending, 'cut red tape for small businesses,' and stop 'unfair parking tickets.'

source.title: City of Montebello - 2026 Candidate Statement: Elva "Sammy" Osorio

elva-sammy-osorio.text: Prioritizes repairing roads and fixing traffic lights on Whittier and Beverly 'so drivers aren't stuck at red lights,' plus Dial-a-Ride.

source.title: City of Montebello - 2026 Candidate Statement: Elva "Sammy" Osorio

elva-sammy-osorio.text: Says 'Our neighbors shouldn't feel forced out by high costs'; wants a Montebello 'where people can stay.'

source.title: City of Montebello - 2026 Candidate Statement: Elva "Sammy" Osorio

ana-torres.text: Lists priorities: public safety, local businesses, city services, youth and seniors, and 'responsible stewardship of taxpayer dollars.'
